goal: Admin user can capture courier/device codes, search pending orders, confirm association, and ship from Web.
stop_condition: Admin type check passes and panel uses only typed APIs with confirm-before-submit behavior.
non_goals: Do not implement authoritative order eligibility or device availability in the frontend.
Do not add another UI framework.
Do not add customer-facing logistics UI.
expected_evidence: Screenshot or sensory note for core states.
Spec-review and quality-review notes for admin touched files.
unsafe_assumptions: Assuming search results are still valid without backend submit recheck.
Assuming OCR confidence removes the need for manual confirmation.
